messages:
maya: PSA: opened docs PR #3424 to add a short Ubuntu 22.04 podman rootless path for private installer in air-gapped sites. It includes HSM PKCS#11 env var mapping and a basic systemd unit example. Need a quick review for correctness and link paths.

sam: thanks maya — can you paste the main snippet here? I can eyeball the PKCS11 bits.

maya: sure, here's the core snippet:

```bash
# run installer in a podman rootless container with mounted device and certs
mkdir -p ~/.redwood/hsm
podman run --rm -it \
  --device /dev/char-device:rw \
  -v ~/.redwood/hsm:/opt/redwood/hsm:Z \
  -e REDWOOD_PKCS11_MODULE=/opt/redwood/hsm/libpkcs11.so \
  -e REDWOOD_PKCS11_TOKEN_LABEL="site-hsm" \
  --net=none \
  quay.io/redwood/priv-installer:stable \
  /usr/local/bin/installer --airgap /opt/airgap/bundle.tar.gz
```

maya: also added a systemd user unit for starting the container during setup. It uses `Restart=on-failure` and a pre-start check for the token path.

oliver: looks good; two nits: (1) use `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` instead of hardcoding path where possible, (2) prefix `--device` with the correct major:minor tends to break across kernels — suggest recommending `--device` with path fallback.

ben: docs-linter-bot flagged a dead link in the PR to `docs/priv/airgap/README.md` — that anchor moved in a previous commit. I'll push a tiny redirect patch.

docs-linter-bot: :robot_face: Link check failed: `docs/priv/airgap/README.md#hsm-quickstart` -> 404. Suggested fix: point to `docs/priv/hsm/quickstart.md#podman-rootless`.

sam: also can we add a note about SELinux contexts? In the Mount we used `:Z` but rootless podman may need `:z` depending on host context. Add a short sentence.

maya: good catch. I'll update mount flag note and switch to `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` in example. Also will add SELinux sentence and reference for `chcon` troubleshooting.

maya: pushed a follow-up commit updating examples and fixed link to `docs/priv/hsm/quickstart.md#podman-rootless` — PTAL.

oliver: reviewed the updated diff, LGTM. One last suggestion: mention that some HSM vendors require `--privileged` for access to char devices — maybe better to say "may require elevated device access" and link to vendor notes instead of recommending privileged.

ben: merged after CI passes. Thanks all :tada:

maya: thanks folks — will backport to stable-branch and add a short changelog entry.

sam: can someone add a short test to the smoke harness that runs the systemd unit check? small followup.

maya: opening follow-up issue.
